# A2 trainer wiring PLAN (plan only: `scorer_finetune.py` is being changed by SCORER1-IMPL; do not edit it until the Master Mind confirms that has landed)

Anchors are at the pinned tip `d5ec25ec` (`TanitAD Research Lab/Architecture & Inference/Research/2026-09-20-refe-plan/refe/`). Line numbers WILL drift after SCORER1-IMPL lands: re-anchor by the function names, and re-grep each before editing.

## 0. What exists after this stream (labeller side, done and tested)
`behaviour_terms.py` (terms), `behaviour_gate.py` (navtest gate), and three patched files (`navsim_pdm_targets.score_plans(behaviour=False)`, `online_labeller.py`, `label_worker.py`), as diffs in `patches/`. Default OFF; OFF is byte-identical to the tip (proved, see `HANDOFF.md`).
Landing target: the same `refe/` directory, plus `refe/gate_data/` (the three navtest files). The gate FAILS CLOSED when the data is absent.

## 1. Label supply (what the trainer reads)
Two supply paths, same arrays (`[B, M, 5]` q in `behaviour_terms.ORDER = (q_free, q_gap, q_osc, q_stall, q_comf)` plus `[B, M, 5]` applicable mask):
* ONLINE (P6 trainer, `train.py:1511-1517` builds `OL.OnlineLabeller(...)`): add the ctor arg `behaviour=a.behaviour_labels` (new flag, default False). `collect()` then returns the arrays in `info["behaviour"]`, `info["behaviour_act"]`. Not needed for A2 itself.
* OFFLINE side file (what A2's `scorer_finetune.py` fine-tune needs, because it reads banked `--pdm-labels-train` sets, `scorer_finetune.py:1151`): a NEW CLI `behaviour_label.py`, a copy-and-trim of `rl_terms_label.py` (`label_log :398`, `make_record :356`, `side_file_name :371`, `shard_of :383`, `main :427`), calling `behaviour_terms.behaviour_terms(sim, parts)` on `rl_terms_label.executed_states`-style states. Record `{"kind": "behaviour", "key": [log, token, step, rank], "ckpt_step": c, "label_version": v, "q": [M][5], "act": [M][5], "terms_version": "behaviour/1"}`. The navtest gate runs on every `(log, token)` BEFORE a record is written. Not written yet (needs the final constants); about 100 lines.

## 3. Leak test (training labels only, nothing enters inference)
Static: `score_trajectories` (`model.py:699`) takes `trajs, sctx` only. The five new head rows read the SAME `dec_width` features the six PDM rows read; the behaviour labels appear only in the loss (`beh_bce`, `expected_reward_loss`). A grep-test must assert that no `bq`/`bact` name is referenced from `model.py`, `planner.py`, or any eval path (`eval/`), and that `--beh-heads` OFF leaves `state_dict` keys unchanged.
At inference the heads' output may be used as a SELECTOR over REFe's own fan (design section 5, "student is used only as a selector"); it must not be fed back into the generator.
Admissibility check (CLAUDE.md goal-input rule): the labels use ego future, agents and map (all admissible for LABELS, PI 2026-08-03); the student's inputs stay images + `ego_vec` + nav goal. The situation classifier does not appear in any of the five terms.

## 4. Mutation (the design's risk-table row, as an executable check)
**M-SHUF**: build a second label set by PERMUTING `(bq, bact)` across tokens (a fixed-seed derangement of the set index within each log shard, so marginals and per-term activation rates are preserved and only the label-to-scene link is destroyed). Train arm B with it at the same seed and steps.
Required outcome, committed in advance: arm B(M-SHUF) must fall back to the BASE selector on the behaviour readouts: held-out per-term AUC of the behaviour heads within-set within 0.5 +/- 0.03 (cluster-bootstrap over logs), and the selected-plan behaviour factors (q_free, q_gap, q_osc, q_stall, q_comf of the argmax pick, from the labeller) not better than base by more than the replicate floor; while arm B(true labels) must beat M-SHUF on the same readouts. If M-SHUF keeps the gain, the gain did not come from the labels (a leak, a prior, or the listwise re-weighting alone) and the arm is void.
A cheap label-level pre-check, no training: the within-set rank correlation between q_prod and `agg_v1(tg)` is reported per term; a term whose labels are a function of PDMS alone (|rho| > 0.95) adds no information and is dropped before any GPU hour.
